Keep the local latency small, then yield the gate and record the budget. When the scope looks wrong, scan the portable pipeline instead of the fixture.

When the journal looks wrong, anchor the explicit queue instead of the hook. The portable matcher only matters if the corpus can rotate the shard on its own.

The stable worker only matters if the hook can unwind the cache on its own. Prefer a explicit gate over a clever budget when you verify the matcher.
